name: jev-model-picker
description: My name is Jev. I pick your model once, at session start and after /clear. No prompts, no mid-session switches, cache stays warm.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Key for the JEV decision model. Kept in secure storage. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

allowHaiku.title: Route down to Haiku
allowHaiku.description: Off: JEV picks only among Sonnet, Opus and Fable. (default: true)

haikuConfidence.title: Haiku confidence bar
haikuConfidence.description: JEV must be at least this sure (0-1) before downgrading to Haiku; below it the session gets Sonnet. A wrong downgrade costs more than a wrong upgrade. (default: 0.9)
